prompt: please write a regex that has a capture group for a phone number and email in the text
response:
To extract both a phone number and an email address from a text, you can use the following regular expression:

```regex
\b(?:\+?\d{1,3}[-. ]?)?\(?\d{3}\)?[-. ]?\d{3}[-. ]?\d{4}\b|[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+
```

This regex will match phone numbers in various formats and email addresses, capturing them in a single group.
